name: comp-323
title: Rating Dialog
description: A trigger opens a compact dialog with a title strip, a rating question, nine numbered cells from easy to difficult, a free-text box and a full-width Send feedback button.
use: You want a quick numeric satisfaction score plus a written reason in one dialog.
avoid: The question and the 0-8 range are fixed, so a different survey needs a source edit.
a11y: The scale is a real radio group with a legend, but the textarea's label is not bound to it and reduced motion is ignored. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Rating button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a bordered title strip reading Help us improve, a bold two-line question, nine joined square cells numbered 0 to 8, Very easy and Very dificult under the ends, then a labelled textarea and a white full-width Send feedback button.
behaves: Opening fades the dialog over a dimmed page. Hovering lights the border of a rating cell; the clip never commits a choice or text, and Send feedback has no action.
customise: The question, scale range, captions and placeholder are hardcoded; the component exposes no props.
weight: light: One dialog with a radio row and a textarea; no animation beyond transitions.
demo: Question asks how hard it was to set up your account; the textarea placeholder asks how coss.com can improve.
issues: The right caption reads Very dificult, which is misspelled.
Send feedback has no handler, so nothing is submitted.
polishWhy: Clear segmented scale and tidy form; a visible caption typo and inert send lower it.
